Drying Rack: Cortech Meal Tray Drying Rack
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-meal-tray-drying-rack
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/meal-tray-drying-rack/
Spec sheet: Drying rack
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Meal Tray Drying Rack
Current H1: Cortech Meal Tray Drying Rack
Subtitle: Mobile Aluminum Rack for Drying and Storing 120 to 288 Meal Trays
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 96090 / 96704 / 96087 / 96705 / 96706 / 96707 Meal Tray Drying Rack
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Meal Tray Drying Rack is a mobile aluminum rack for drying and storing washed meal trays in correctional and institutional kitchens. Custom inserts hold each tray apart, so air circulates freely for faster drying.
The frame is heavy duty aluminum tubing on platform casters, and the racks come in six sizes that hold 120 to 288 trays. They ship knocked down and carry a lifetime warranty against rust and corrosion.
Material: Heavy duty aluminum frame of 1½”×1¾” tubing
Tray Guides: 0.09” thick guides with 2.65” wide tray slots
Capacity: 120 to 288 trays, depending on the model
Casters: Platform casters
Dimensions: 59”D×28”W×50½”H (2-level 96090) or 59”D×28”W×74½”H (3-level 96087)
Weight: 159 lbs (96090) or 219 lbs (96087)
Certification: NSF
Shipping: Ships knocked down; fully welded options available
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against rust and corrosion; 5-year warranty against workmanship and material defects
Country of Manufacture: USA
Available Models and Options
96090 – 120 Trays: 2 tray levels, 159 lbs
96704 – 150 Trays: Drying rack
96087 – 180 Trays: 3 tray levels, 219 lbs
96705 – 200 Trays: Drying rack
96706 – 216 Trays: Drying rack
96707 – 288 Trays: Drying rack
Installation and Options
Assembly: Ships knocked down; some assembly required
[H2] Applications
The drying rack suits kitchens that wash and dry large numbers of meal trays every day.
Typical applications include:
Central kitchens in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Institutional kitchens that serve meals on trays
Tray washing and storage areas
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (51 characters): Cortech Aluminum Meal Tray Drying Rack at Anchortex
Meta description (150 characters): Shop the Cortech Meal Tray Drying Rack. A mobile aluminum rack on casters for drying and storing 120 to 288 meal trays, with a lifetime rust warranty.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
Spec sheet: the Cortech spec sheet gives details only for the 96090 (2 levels) and 96087 (3 levels). It describes them as holding twenty 18”×26” trays per level, which are sheet pans, while your variants and the Cortech web page give capacities in meal trays. I used the meal tray capacities from your variants and gave dimensions and weights only for those two models. Can you get details for the other four models from Cortech?
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says 159 lbs (96090) and 219 lbs (96087); it gives no weight for the other four models.
Casters: the Cortech spec sheet says four 5” platform casters, and the Cortech web page says 6”×2” platform-type swivel casters, so I wrote "Platform casters" only.
Price: your 96090 variant has the same price and compare-at price ($4,100). The other variants are priced at 80% of compare-at. Can you check the 96090 price?
Warranty: your current page says "Lifetime Guarantee against rust and corrosion." The Cortech spec sheet adds a 5-year warranty against workmanship and material defects, so I added it.
About Cortech: this rack is aluminum, not molded, but I kept the standard "About Cortech" paragraph.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has the same photo. I did not find other photos.
